## Données des taux par canton

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

file_path <- file.path(input_raw_dir, "Tamedia_20260312.xlsx")

# Noms de colonnes courts définis manuellement (les headers Excel sont sur plusieurs lignes)
col_names_clean <- c(
  "canton",
  "n",
  "meme_ecole_meme_domaine",
  "autre_ecole_meme_type_meme_domaine",
  "meme_ecole_autre_domaine",
  "autre_ecole_autre_type_autre_domaine",
  "hes",
  "hep",
  "echec_restant",
  "echec_abandon_ch",
  "echec_abandon_hors_ch"
)

read_canton_sheet <- function(path, sheet) {
  year <- as.integer(str_extract(sheet, "\\d{4}"))
  
  read_excel(
    path,
    sheet     = sheet,
    skip      = 4,          # saute titre + lignes de headers
    col_names = col_names_clean,
    col_types = c("text", rep("numeric", 10))
  ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(canton),
      # !str_detect(canton, "^Total$"),
      # !str_detect(canton, "Valeur non"),
      !str_detect(canton, "Sources: Projet LABB"),
      !str_detect(canton, "renseignements: pascal"),

    ) %>%
    mutate(
  canton = case_when(
    canton == "Total"                          ~ "Suisse",
    str_detect(canton, "^Valeur non")          ~ "Unknown",
    .default = canton
  )
) %>% 


    mutate(annee = year) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = -c(canton, n, annee),
      names_to  = "categorie",
      values_to = "pct"
    )
}

df_long <- map_dfr(canton_sheets, ~ read_canton_sheet(file_path, .x)) %>% 
      mutate(canton_code = canton_codes[canton])

unique(df_long$canton)


df_long %>% write_csv(file.path(input_processed_dir, "df_bfs_delivery_canton_rate.csv"))
```

## Données des taux par canton x universités

```{r}

read_canton_heu_sheet <- function(path, sheet) {
  year <- as.integer(str_extract(sheet, "\\d{4}"))
  
  raw <- read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text")
  colnames(raw) <- c("heu", "n", col_names_clean[3:11])
  
  raw %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(heu),
      !str_detect(heu, "^Taux de r"),
      !str_detect(heu, "^Sources|^renseignements"),
      is.na(n) | n != "N"            # ← fix : garde séparateurs ET filtre headers
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      is_separator = is.na(n),
      canton = if_else(is_separator, heu, NA_character_)
    ) %>%
    fill(canton, .direction = "down") %>%
    filter(!is_separator) %>%
    select(-is_separator) %>%
    mutate(across(-c(canton, heu), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      annee = year,
      canton = case_when(
        str_detect(canton, "^Valeur non") ~ "Unknown",
        .default = canton
      ),
      canton_code = canton_codes[canton]
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = -c(canton, canton_code, heu, n, annee),
      names_to  = "categorie",
      values_to = "pct"
    )
}

df_heu_long <- map_dfr(canton_HEU_sheets, ~ read_canton_heu_sheet(file_path, .x))


df_heu_long %>% write_csv(file.path(input_processed_dir, "df_bfs_delivery_canton_university_rate.csv"))
```

```{r}
read_canton_group_sheet <- function(path, sheet, group_var = "heu") {
  year <- as.integer(str_extract(sheet, "\\d{4}"))
  raw <- read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text")
  colnames(raw) <- c(group_var, "n", col_names_clean[3:11])
  
  raw %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[group_var]]),
      !str_detect(.data[[group_var]], "^Taux de r"),
      !str_detect(.data[[group_var]], "^Sources|^renseignements"),
      is.na(n) | n != "N"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      is_separator = is.na(n),
      canton = if_else(is_separator, .data[[group_var]], NA_character_)
    ) %>%
    fill(canton, .direction = "down") %>%
    filter(!is_separator) %>%
    select(-is_separator) %>%
    mutate(across(-c(canton, .data[[group_var]]), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(
      annee = year,
      canton = case_when(
        str_detect(canton, "^Valeur non") ~ "Unknown",
        .default = canton
      ),
      canton_code = canton_codes[canton]
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols      = -c(canton, canton_code, all_of(group_var), n, annee),
      names_to  = "categorie",
      values_to = "pct"
    )
}

# Usage
df_heu_long     <- map_dfr(canton_HEU_sheets,     ~ read_canton_group_sheet(file_path, .x, "heu"))
df_domaine_long <- map_dfr(canton_Domaine_sheets, ~ read_canton_group_sheet(file_path, .x, "domaine"))


df_domaine_long %>%  write_csv(file.path(input_processed_dir, "df_bfs_delivery_canton_domain_rate.csv"))
```
